name: magdiwang-water-system
description: Magdiwang Water Supply System (Cloudflare Workers + D1)

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && node scripts/make-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=seed/staging-seed.sql
scripts.migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.seed:staging: node scripts/make-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --env staging --remote --file=seed/staging-seed.sql
